papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and anisotropy in mechanical properties of A357 alloy produced by selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金SLM工艺与热处理，不涉及生物医用植入物或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant application, no porous structure, and no stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM成形A357合金微观组织及力学性能各向异性的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备试样，进行不同热处理，测试力学性能并分析微观组织
summary_zh.result: 热处理可减少各向异性，提升力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、拉伸试验等实验手段验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical anisotropy of A357 alloy produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM, subjected to different heat treatments, and then mechanical testing and microstructural characterization were performed.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment reduces mechanical anisotropy and improves overall mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation through SEM observation and tensile testing.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of half-Heusler thermoelectric materials
papers.abstract: Traditional thermoelectric device manufacturing uses machining, assembly, and integration steps which lead to material waste and performance limitations. The approach offers little flexibility in designing thermoelectric module geometry. Additive manufacturing can overcome these challenges, but it has not been demonstrated for inorganic thermoelectric materials, particularly those geared toward mid-/high-temperature applications. This work describes selective laser melting, an additive manufacturing process which locally melts successive layers of material powder to construct three-dimensional objects. The work shows the firstever demonstrations of selective laser melting applied to half-Heusler thermoelectric materials: ZrNiSn, and Hf<sub>0.3</sub>Zr<sub>0.7</sub>CoSn<sub>0.3</sub>Sb<sub>0.7</sub>/nano-Zr<sub>O2</sub>. Laser processing parameters critically affects the formation and appearance of ingots, and we found laser energy density is useful but cannot be the single consideration for the SLM process. The fabricated ingots are generally porous with rough surfaces. They are characterized through powder XRD and TGA. The results consistently show that produced parts preserved most of the original chemical structures with small chemical changes due to decomposition and oxidation during the selective laser melting process. The work demonstrates selective laser melting is feasible for half-Heusler thermoelectric materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究热电材料而非生物医学材料，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on thermoelectric materials and does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, mechanical testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 首次证明选区激光熔化可用于半霍斯勒热电材料制造
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM工艺参数优化制备ZrNiSn和Hf0.3Zr0.7CoSn0.3Sb0.7/nano-ZrO2样品
summary_zh.result: 样品保持原始化学结构但存在多孔和粗糙表面，激光能量密度非唯一因素

summary_en.motivation: To demonstrate the feasibility of selective laser melting for fabricating half-Heusler thermoelectric materials, overcoming limitations of traditional manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was applied to ZrNiSn and Hf0.3Zr0.7CoSn0.3Sb0.7/nano-ZrO2 powders with varying laser parameters.
summary_en.result: The fabricated parts preserved most of the original chemical structures but exhibited porosity and rough surfaces; laser energy density alone is insufficient for process control.
summary_en.validation: Chemical and structural integrity were evaluated using powder XRD and TGA.

papers.title: Accelerated Corrosion Analysis of AlSi10Mg Alloy Manufactured by Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
papers.abstract: The Selective Laser Melting (SLM) technology uses metal powders as building material which is melted and welded together using a high-power laser in order to obtain quick configuration of complex parts, most often for testing them. Another advantage of this method is the fact that allows obtaining any 3D geometry of the parts, even parts that cannot be processed through conventional manufacturing procedures. In this work were performed a number of tests for accelerated corrosion of AlSi10Mg alloy specimens in order to determine their mean life in the conditions of their use in a high salinity environment. For specimens, optical analysis was used the SEM microscope which has the advantage of obtaining an enlarged image of the investigated objects without processing. Following these analyses, it has been determined the mass loss of specimens due to corrosion.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造AlSi10Mg合金的加速腐蚀，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on corrosion behavior of AlSi10Mg in saline environments, with no LPBF fabrication of porous structures, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SLM制造AlSi10Mg合金在高盐环境中的寿命
summary_zh.method: 对试样进行加速腐蚀测试并使用SEM分析质量损失
summary_zh.result: 测定了腐蚀导致的质量损失和平均寿命
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM观察和称重验证腐蚀效果

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the service life of SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg alloy under high-salinity corrosive environments.
summary_en.method: Accelerated corrosion tests were conducted on AlSi10Mg specimens, followed by mass loss measurement and SEM microscopy.
summary_en.result: The mass loss due to corrosion was quantified, providing an estimate of mean life for the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed via accelerated corrosion testing and microscopic surface analysis.

papers.title: Micro machinability of net shapes of Selective Laser Melting of Ti-6Al-4V for minimum material removal using ball end mill

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光选区熔化Ti-6Al-4V近净成形件的微切削加工性，不涉及生物医用植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on machinability of SLM Ti-6Al-4V net shapes, with no evaluation of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM Ti-6Al-4V近净成形件的微切削加工性以减少材料去除量。
summary_zh.method: 使用球头立铣刀进行微切削加工实验。
summary_zh.result: 提出了最小材料去除的加工方法。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the micro machinability of net-shaped Ti-6Al-4V parts produced by selective laser melting for minimal material removal.
summary_en.method: Micro machining experiments were conducted using ball end mills on SLM Ti-6Al-4V net shapes.
summary_en.result: An approach for minimizing material removal during post-processing of SLM parts was demonstrated.
summary_en.validation: No specific validation is reported in the abstract.
